task.question: What was the number of participants in the anti-war protest in Japan in April 2026?
task.evidence: April 8 – Thirty thousand people participate in an anti-war and anti-constitutional amendment protest in front of the National Diet Building in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Similar protests are also held in 150 other places across Japan.

answer:
The number of participants in the anti-war protest in Japan on March 25, 2026, was 24,000 demonstrators. 

FINAL: 24000
